title: Player Guarantee
body_html:
Player Guarantee

In a zero-sum game $(I,J,g)$, player 1 guarantees $w$ if there exists $i \in I$ such that $g(i,j) \ge w$ for every $j \in J$. Player 2 guarantees $w$ if there exists $j \in J$ such that $g(i,j) \le w$ for every $i \in I$.

References

  • [MFoGT, Def. 2.2.2] Laraki, Renault, and Sorin, Mathematical Foundations of Game Theory, references/MechDesign.pdf. Guarantees for both players in a zero-sum game.
